title: Ul-Ji

symbol.name: Ul-Ji
symbol.meaning: General Eulji Mundeok · ITF pattern 20 of 24

note.p: Ul-Ji is named after General Eulji Mundeok, who defended Korea in 612 against an invasion force of nearly a million soldiers led by Yang Je; with hit-and-run tactics he destroyed a large part of it. The diagram 乙 is his surname. The 42 movements stand for the age of the author (General Choi Hong Hi) when he designed the pattern. You start in parallel stance with an X-back hand facing D: a twin side fist strike, X-fist and X-knife-hand blocks and a knife-hand strike; back hand, elbow and back fist strikes in sitting stance with a crescent kick; twin elbow thrusts, an X-stance and a side kick; a twin knife-hand block and mid-air spinning kick toward B; a jump into X-stance; rising block, front kick, punch and fingertip thrust; then on the E–F line a flying high kick, checking, pressing and wedging blocks, twin punches, guarding blocks, turning and back kicks, circular blocks and two punches in sitting stance to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (42 movements, one technique each). The moves go along the three lines of the 乙 diagram and back, so the board shows them in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of a line parallel to A–B (F on the B side); DF, DE, ED and BD are diagonals. Finish by bringing the left foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the start facing D in parallel stance with an X-back hand.
Move the left foot back to C into a right walking stance facing D. Twin side fist horizontal strike.
Move the right foot back to C into a left walking stance facing D. X-fist pressing block.
In the same stance, X-knife-hand rising block, straight on from 2.
In the same stance, right knife-hand high front strike, the left palm on the right elbow joint.
Move the left foot to C into a sitting stance facing B. Left back hand horizontal strike toward C.
Right middle crescent kick into the left palm.
Lower the right foot toward C into a sitting stance facing A. Right front elbow strike into the left palm.
In the same stance, left back elbow thrust toward B, the right side fist on the left fist.
In the same stance, right back fist side back strike toward B, the left arm extended down to the side.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance facing D. Twin side elbow thrust.
Cross the left foot over the right foot into a right X-stance facing D, turning the face to A, the hands held where they were, fast.
Right middle side piercing kick toward A, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward A, then cross the left foot over the right foot into a right X-stance facing D. Twin elbow horizontal thrust.
Move the right foot to A into a sitting stance facing D. Right horizontal punch toward A.
Stand up, facing D. Right knife-hand high front strike, the back of the left hand in front of the forehead.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin knife-hand block.
Jump and spin clockwise: right mid-air spinning kick toward B.
Land toward B in a right walking stance. Right double forearm middle block.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into close ready stance B facing D.
Jump toward D, landing in a right X-stance facing BD. Right back fist high side strike toward B, the left fingertips on the right side fist.
Move the left foot back to C into a right walking stance facing D. Left forearm rising block.
Left middle front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D into a left walking stance. Right high punch.
Move the right foot to D into a right walking stance. Right straight fingertip middle thrust.
Move the left foot to D, turning counter-clockwise into a sitting stance facing A. Left back fist high side strike toward D.
Move the right foot to F, turning counter-clockwise into a right walking ready stance facing F.
Jump: right flying high kick toward F.
Land toward F in a right fixed stance facing F (right foot forward). X-knife-hand checking block.
Move the left foot to F into a right L-stance facing F (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). X-fist pressing block.
Left middle side front snap kick toward F with an inner forearm wedging block.
Lower the left foot toward F into a left walking stance. Twin fist high vertical punch.
Move the right foot to F into a right fixed stance facing F (right foot forward). Right knife-hand middle outward block and left palm middle pushing block, together.
Slide toward F into a right L-stance facing F (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left middle side punch.
Move the left foot to the side rear of the right foot and the right foot toward E, into a right L-stance facing F; then jump toward E, keeping the stance. Forearm middle guarding block.
Right middle turning kick toward DF.
Lower the right foot toward F, then left middle back piercing kick toward F.
Lower the left foot toward F into a right L-stance facing F (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the left foot to E into a left L-stance facing F (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right palm upward block.
Move the right foot to E into a right walking stance facing E. Left inner forearm circular block toward ED.
Turn into a right walking stance facing DF. Right inner forearm circular block toward DE.
Move the left foot along the E–F line into a sitting stance facing D. Left middle punch.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
